transitions.predicate: Fresh validated state, valid accepted packet, healthy enforcement/clock/actuators, confirmed queue/session reset, adequate response margin and explicit authorized arming.
transitions.action: Grant new session/epoch; record all admission evidence.
transitions.s1_guard: DISARMED; no uncleared critical latch; explicit operator arming; G_NOMINAL and acknowledged new-session queue/epoch barrier.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transitions.predicate: Current authority still admissible but renewal/response budget, uncertainty or fault indication approaches its reviewed intervention boundary.
transitions.action: Request renewal; assess alternatives; log reserve and timing components.
transitions.s1_guard: NORMAL; current nominal authority remains eligible; named warning policy evidence indicates renewal/response concern.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transitions.predicate: Renewal accepted, domain/health restored and approved hysteresis/stability evidence satisfied; no latched emergency.
transitions.action: Clear warning with causal evidence; hysteresis values remain unresolved.
transitions.s1_guard: WARNING; fresh accepted renewal and eligible nominal evidence; approved warning-clear/hysteresis evidence; no critical latch.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transitions.predicate: Recovery eligibility holds for reachable uncertainty and actuators; risk assessment favors recovery over stop.
transitions.action: Change owner through current-epoch grant and acknowledged queue handling.
transitions.s1_guard: NORMAL/WARNING; named RECOVERY evidence SATISFIED for entire declared fixture context and independently supplied selection evidence favors it.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transitions.predicate: Verified conservative policy remains feasible and its destination/stop transfer is assured within declared bounds.
transitions.action: Authorize that policy and validate every application/hold.
transitions.s1_guard: NORMAL/WARNING/RECOVERY; named DECELERATION and destination/transfer evidence SATISFIED.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transitions.predicate: Emergency demand, recovery not preferable/available, or intervention boundary requires stopping.
transitions.action: Latch stop request; assess D_STOP; do not delay emergency demand awaiting an optimizer.
transitions.s1_guard: DISARMED/NORMAL/WARNING/RECOVERY/DECELERATING; emergency demand or selected stop response; latch and revoke nominal grants immediately.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transitions.predicate: Validated D_STOP and independent endpoint acknowledgement for the correct session/epoch.
transitions.action: Record actual stop-policy activation; monitor progress and deadlines.
transitions.s1_guard: STOP_REQUESTED; named STOP evidence SATISFIED and matching endpoint activation acknowledgement observed; request alone fails.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transitions.predicate: Validated rest and hold confirmed; no unresolved actuation/communication ambiguity.
transitions.action: Latch achieved rest with evidence; preserve fault history.
transitions.s1_guard: STOPPING; independent named REST_HOLD evidence SATISFIED; no unresolved endpoint/session ambiguity.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transitions.predicate: No eligible policy exists, critical uncertainty is unbounded, or response/ack bounds violated.
transitions.action: Revoke software permission; request only characterized emergency response; declare residual uncontrolled hazard.
transitions.s1_guard: Any listed S0 source state; continuation and all alternate policy evidence absent, UNKNOWN or VIOLATED; or required application-state/response knowledge lost.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transitions.predicate: Independently validated emergency response is now available, domain and endpoint acknowledgement confirmed.
transitions.action: Remain fault-latched; execute response without relabeling prior uncontrolled interval.
transitions.s1_guard: NO_VALID_POLICY; named STOP evidence now SATISFIED and matching endpoint acknowledgement observed; preserve all fault history and uncontrolled interval.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transitions.predicate: Independent valid rest/hold evidence obtained even if stop action history is incomplete.
transitions.action: Preserve unknown prior application data; do not invent successful braking.
transitions.s1_guard: NO_VALID_POLICY; independent named REST_HOLD evidence SATISFIED, even if past actuation is unknown; preserve unknown history.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transitions.predicate: Verified terminal recovery set reached, new nominal authority accepted, transition feasible and separately approved reentry policy permits.
transitions.action: No automatic racing reentry until hysteresis/dwell and epoch checks are approved.
transitions.s1_guard: RECOVERY/DECELERATING; named terminal/transfer, new nominal authority, reentry/dwell and epoch-barrier evidence SATISFIED; enter WARNING, not direct NORMAL.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transitions.predicate: Authorized reset, faults cleared, inspected actuator/state/clock health and invalidated old session/queue.
transitions.action: Re-arm only via T01; reset is not a direct racing grant.
transitions.s1_guard: STOPPED_LATCHED; explicit authorized reset, cleared fault causes, independent rest/health evidence and acknowledged invalidation of old session/queues; enter DISARMED.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transitions.predicate: Rest/holding confidence lost or unexpected motion/power/actuator fault.
transitions.action: Revoke rest claim; report fault and invoke eligible independent response.
transitions.s1_guard: STOPPED_LATCHED; lost rest/holding confidence or unexpected motion/power/actuator fault; revoke rest claim and latch NO_VALID_POLICY.
transitions.positive_fixture_coverage: Deferred unless explicitly named in initial_scenario_oracles.json; retained in design for all nine states.

transition_rules: Evaluate emergency before permissive transitions. If stop feasibility is unknown, record T06 then T09 in the same transaction; no grant may occur between them.
A rejection need not itself change supervisor state when current authority remains eligible; if authority/estimate/evidence is invalid and no alternate exists, take T09.
Malformed untrusted proposal is rejected without corrupting valid active authority; identity conflict in a recognized session is a critical latched fault.
No eligible transition means NO_CHANGE with reason, not an invented edge. Permissive simultaneous guards require explicit named selection evidence; ambiguity denies grant.
Each transaction records its complete transition path. Fault history remains append-only even after approved clearance.

For planned authority changes, a sealed timestamp batch may install/ack a matching barrier before accepting replacement authority. Evaluate the no-policy closure after phase2 and before any phase4 permission/phase5 commit. If a barrier remains unacknowledged without separately eligible continuation/response, latch T09. A critical fault never waits for this closure.

common_guards.G_NOMINAL: Current accepted packet interval contains entire requested/held permission; current state VALID and fresh through hold; frame/map, uncertainty interpretation, named NOMINAL and HEALTH evidence SATISFIED; no critical latch; acknowledged queue/session/epoch barrier.
common_guards.G_CONTINUE: All live permission conditions remain eligible; a DEGRADED/stale estimate requires a separate named CONTINUATION policy with reviewed bounded evidence. Otherwise no continuation.
common_guards.G_ALTERNATE: Named RECOVERY/DECELERATION/STOP policy evidence is SATISFIED for current state/uncertainty, actuator, timing, terminal/transfer context; UNKNOWN is ineligible. These remain synthetic assumptions in S1.
common_guards.G_REST: Independent REST_HOLD fixture evidence in current context and valid interval; not an application acknowledgement, zero command, loop termination or missing motion sample.
common_guards.G_RESET: T13 only: explicit operator authorization, cleared initiating causes, current health/rest and acknowledged old-session/queue invalidation; no direct nominal grant.

phases.effect: Invalidate elapsed grants, install delivered revocation/cancellation, latch faults before permissive work. Expiry applies even without a message.
Record observed synthetic outcome/barrier delivery; never rewrite original commit time or source. Unknown acknowledgement is not a negative application result.
Incorporate available positive evidence, delivered messages and independently accepted authority; no latch is cleared implicitly. Invalid endpoint estimate/evidence delivery is phase0.
Evaluate guarded state transitions and requested protocol work. Requesting cancellation alone has no endpoint effect.
Check current identities, uncertainty, evidence and bounded lease; decisions are logical only.
S1-B only: recheck endpoint-local state immediately before atomic simulated application.
Observe outcomes generated by this batch; causal acknowledgement never precedes its decision/commit.

ordering.same_producer: Producer sequences strictly increase; duplicate exact event returns prior trace; conflicting event identity is rejected.
ordering.cross_producer: Lexical tie-break applies only within a phase; phase/fault priority wins over arrival enumeration. Fault and healthy input at the same tick cannot clear a latch.
ordering.generated_events: Outputs cannot be backdated. Same-tick causal outputs use increasing microstep and retain parent IDs. Newly discovered critical failure updates the latch/deny gate synchronously before any remaining permission/commit; it cannot wait behind a permissive event.
ordering.unexpected_late_event: A newly received message about an earlier remote occurrence is recorded at current receipt time with the earlier source stamp; it cannot reorder completed commits or erase history.
ordering.boundary_processing: ADVANCE visits every known lease/evidence/freshness boundary crossed; invalidate at earliest boundary before processing later input. No wall-clock polling or missed message can extend a lease.

invariants.title: Three gates
invariants.assertion: Proposal readiness, accepted packet authority and a live application permission are distinct records and decisions.

invariants.title: One owner
invariants.assertion: No timestamp/linearization point has two active authority owners or conflicting live grants for the same endpoint scope.

invariants.title: Conservative time
invariants.assertion: All required mapped bounds and causal orders hold; start <= application_min <= application_max <= latest < end; hold_end <= end.

invariants.title: No extension
invariants.assertion: Permission end never exceeds original source expiry or applicable evidence validity; reauthorization cannot extend the packet.

invariants.title: Freshness and quality
invariants.assertion: Nominal grant requires VALID, finite, correctly framed/mapped state and interpreted uncertainty through application/hold. Unknown/DEGRADED denies new nominal authority.

invariants.title: Epoch/session
invariants.assertion: Grant uses desired current epoch; application requires matching locally installed epoch/session and acknowledged barrier. Old command generation epoch/source remains unchanged.

invariants.title: At-most-once
invariants.assertion: Duplicate command or acknowledgement never causes a second grant/commit; ID/payload conflict is rejected and critically latched.

invariants.title: Cancellation knowledge
invariants.assertion: Request, endpoint delivery, cancellation acknowledgement and TOO_LATE are distinct. No retroactive cancellation of an applied input.

invariants.title: Held knowledge
invariants.assertion: Grant rejection, expiry or revocation never erases held input or proves removal. Missing feedback remains unknown with reason.

invariants.title: Priority
invariants.assertion: Known emergency, invalid evidence, expiry and installed revocation/cancellation precede every permissive decision/commit in the sealed time batch.

invariants.title: No-policy truth
invariants.assertion: Absent eligible continuation/recovery/deceleration/stop or bounded knowledge enters NO_VALID_POLICY; no default zero/brake/off or stopping claim.

invariants.title: Latching
invariants.assertion: Emergency/critical latches survive supervisor object restart via explicit snapshot input; no healthy sample or operator reset alone clears them.

invariants.title: Controlled reentry
invariants.assertion: No direct NO_VALID_POLICY-to-NORMAL or STOPPED_LATCHED-to-NORMAL path; T11/T13/T01 or separately reviewed S0 path and new session/barrier required.

invariants.title: Causal evidence
invariants.assertion: Decisions use only received evidence by that time; parents precede children; future endpoint/plant truth cannot enter the reducer.

invariants.title: Claim separation
invariants.assertion: A emits logical decisions only; B records SIMULATED_* outcomes only; physical feedback is always null in this contract.

invariants.title: Architecture independence
invariants.assertion: Actual source timestamps and acceptance evidence determine authority, independent of optimizer, stage count, grid shape or preparation duration.

invariants.title: No resurrection
invariants.assertion: Expired, acknowledged-cancelled, previously applied or superseded work never regains application eligibility by replay/reset.

invariants.title: Evidence scope
invariants.assertion: Synthetic SATISFIED assumptions are labelled; they neither validate physical domains nor establish measured timing or braking.

persistence.S1_A: Pure reducer consumes/returns Snapshot. Restart scenarios supply a retained snapshot explicitly; no disk, MCU or power-failure durability is implemented.
persistence.missing_or_corrupt_snapshot: Boot into DISARMED with arming denied; latch PERSISTENCE_UNKNOWN and take T09. Do not interpret absent fault history as cleared.
persistence.new_session: Invalidate old endpoint session/queue via acknowledged barrier; preserve historical latches and ledgers. Old session requests remain rejected after rearming.
persistence.hardware: Durable storage, atomic writes, independent enforcement and behavior during power loss require HW05-HW08 characterization and later authorization.

decision_precedence: Reject malformed/version/nonfinite/causality-invalid records first; do not mutate valid authority from an unauthenticated malformed proposal.
For recognized session/identity conflicts, record/latch the critical fault before any permissive handling.

For permission, application and endpoint-commit operations: current session and effective local epoch/revocation/cancellation checks precede lease/latest-time, fault/quality/domain and duplicate outcome checks. Record all applicable reason codes in this group order.

COMMAND_SUBMIT exact duplicate may replay historical receipt outcome without any live authorization meaning. Repeated PERMISSION_REQUEST replays only if current guards remain admissible; never issues a second grant.

ENDPOINT_COMMIT after epoch change/cancellation/expiry is rejected with that cause, even if an earlier application exists; retain the earlier application in history. Under unchanged admissible local conditions an exact duplicate returns the prior outcome without a new commit.
A command newly submitted and its first distinct permission request are not duplicate operations. REAUTHORIZE is separately keyed by new permission/transition identity.

oracle_independence.required: Expected outcomes are literal reviewed tables and independently computed interval/identity/at-most-once assertions; future checker must not call the reducer, endpoint or their guard/order helpers to obtain expected results.
oracle_independence.evidence: Retain initial configuration, input event list, expected table, actual complete trace, schema/version/source/config hashes and failed/censored outcomes in new task evidence directories.
oracle_independence.anti_tautology: No regenerated golden traces from the system under test. Any expected-table change requires review with the changed predicate and rationale.
oracle_independence.scope: No oracle executed in this specification delivery.
